## Mova 1.8.0

Mova 1.8.0 在删除找不到的媒体之前，先确认媒体库所在的存储确实连接着。以前只要一轮扫描成功遍历完目录，没见到的文件就会被删除；NAS 共享在容器启动时还没挂上、单独挂在库根目录下面的盘没有连接、或者目录被从部署配置里移除，都会把媒体条目连同播放进度和已看记录一起删掉。

现在每个媒体库在扫描成功后记录它所在的挂载（挂载点、文件系统类型和来源）。只有库根目录享受保留待遇：库根目录所在的网络存储（SMB/CIFS、NFS 等）没有连接、无法读取或超时时，媒体库进入“存储不可用”状态，拒绝扫描、不删除任何内容，管理员会收到通知，库主和管理员可以在提示里直接删除该媒体库；存储恢复后自动恢复可用。库根目录在本地盘上出问题，以及库根目录下方任何读不出的内容，包括单独挂载的盘或共享和没有权限的文件夹，都视为不存在，对应条目被移除，其余部分照常扫描。存储已连接且确实没有文件时，媒体库会被清空；原来“整库突然零个文件就拒绝删除”的保护已移除。目标不存在的符号链接不再让整个媒体库扫描失败。媒体库的全部目录都从部署配置中移除时，服务启动时直接删除该媒体库。

公开接口新增媒体库的 `storage_status`、`storage_issue`（仅库主和管理员可见）和 `storage_unavailable_since` 字段，存储不可用时扫描请求返回 `409 library_storage_unavailable`，并新增 `library.storage.unavailable` 和 `library.removed_from_deployment` 两种管理员通知；选择文件夹时读不出的目录不再让整个目录树加载失败。本版本包含迁移 `0007_library_storage`，升级时自动原地执行，不需要重新扫描或重建缓存；保护从每个媒体库升级后的第一次成功扫描起生效。部署文档补充了多盘布局、容器启动顺序以及 Mova 无法识别的情况（NAS 内部磁盘故障但共享仍在、mergerfs 等合并目录、Docker Desktop 的子挂载）。

---

## Mova 1.8.0

Mova 1.8.0 confirms that a library's storage is connected before it removes media it cannot find. Previously any scan that finished traversing the directory deleted every file it did not see: a NAS share not yet mounted when the container started, a disk mounted below the library root that was not connected, or a folder removed from the deployment all deleted media items together with playback progress and watched state.

Each library now records the mounts it lives on (mount point, filesystem type and source) after a successful scan. Only the library root gets the benefit of the doubt: when the network storage (SMB/CIFS, NFS and similar) holding the root is not connected, cannot be read or times out, the library becomes storage unavailable, scans are refused, nothing is removed, admins are notified, and owners and admins can delete the library from the notice; it recovers by itself once the storage is back. A failing local root, and anything below the root that cannot be read, including separately mounted disks or shares and permission-denied folders, is treated as nonexistent, so its media is removed while the rest of the library scans normally. Connected storage that really has no files empties the library; the former whole-library zero-file guard is gone. A link whose target no longer exists no longer fails the whole scan. A library whose every folder was removed from the deployment is deleted at startup.

The public API gains `storage_status`, `storage_issue` (owners and admins only) and `storage_unavailable_since` on library objects, scans of an unavailable library return `409 library_storage_unavailable`, and two admin notifications, `library.storage.unavailable` and `library.removed_from_deployment`, are added; the folder picker leaves out folders it cannot read instead of failing. This release contains migration `0007_library_storage`, applied in place at startup, and requires no rescan or cache rebuild; protection starts with each library's first successful scan after the upgrade. The deployment guide now covers multi-disk layouts, container start order and the cases Mova cannot detect (a NAS-internal disk failure behind a live share, pooled folders such as mergerfs, Docker Desktop sub-mounts).
